body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Jiwu Media(www.jiwumedia.com) introduced 'Miracle1 NBD-001' which sends the video of laptop wirelessly using USB at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
